caption: The drawing depicts a wrought iron fence design, primarily in shades of brown and sepia on a light beige background. The central feature is a large cross formed by a vertical bar intersected by a horizontal bar, both with pointed tips. Ornamental curls and spirals extend symmetrically from both the top and sides of the cross, with each side having a prominent outward and upward curl. The base of the cross is attached to a flat horizontal bar, which is supported by three vertical bars extending downward. On each end of the horizontal bar at the bottom, there are finial-like posts with rounded tops. The background is plain with faint horizontal and vertical lines suggesting architectural or structural elements behind the ironwork.
title: Wrought Iron Cross
